name: Kinesis Gold
oneLiner: KAU (ERC-20) is KMS Labs' Ethereum gold token backed 1:1 by native Kinesis KAU; physical redemption is two-step and ERC-20 balances do not earn fee yield.
collateral: 1:1 reserves of Kinesis-native KAU held by KMS Labs S.A. (Panama); native KAU is in turn backed 1:1 by LBMA-approved allocated physical gold in ABX vaults.
pegMechanism: ERC-20 KAU is redeemable for Kinesis-native KAU through KMS Labs after compliance onboarding, then for physical gold through Kinesis Cayman subject to platform terms; no Kinesis fee-yield accrues on ERC-20 balances.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bureau Veritas Commodities UK Ltd (Inspectorate International; commodity vault inspection under agreed procedures with no opinion - the token-vs-metal comparison exists only in the issuer cover letter, whose signatory heads both Kinesis and the vault operator ABX)

mintAuthority.summary: KAU is a Fireblocks ERC20F UUPS proxy on Ethereum. mint() is onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) with no on-chain cap, held by a single EOA (0x4b1f9e5b…). A separate single EOA (0xe584e152…) holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which is the role admin for every role, so it can grant itself UPGRADER_ROLE and replace the implementation. No UPGRADER_ROLE holder currently exists. KAG and KAU use the same ERC20F implementation but distinct minter/admin EOAs and distinct DenyList registries. Minting is operationally gated off-chain by Kinesis deposits of allocated gold bullion, not by contract logic.

controls.label: Kinesis KAU minter EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530887, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x4b1f9e5b20e8b9949b3db4b3ef5887f49d69c8dd) on the KAU proxy returns true and eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). The verified ERC20F source defines mint(address,uint256) as onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) with no supply cap or per-minter allowance, so this key can mint an unbounded amount; canRaiseCap is true because no numeric cap exists to raise. Role granted at deployment block 23337251 and never revoked.

controls.label: Kinesis KAU default-admin EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530887, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xe584e152bed254a177351cea587aa44c2a83a8ae) and hasRole(CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xe584e152bed254a177351cea587aa44c2a83a8ae) both return true; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). getRoleAdmin() for MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE all return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so this single key can grant MINTER_ROLE to any address and can grant itself UPGRADER_ROLE, whose sole power in ERC20F is _authorizeUpgrade. No timelock, multisig, or guard sits in front of it.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530887 the KAU proxy 0x14dab79fd7b7b3f748d434812fd6a9aac460ea52 has EIP-1967 implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 (ERC20F, verified) and an EIP-1967 admin slot of zero; proxiableUUID() reverts with the UUPSUpgradeable delegatecall guard, confirming UUPS rather than a transparent proxy with a ProxyAdmin. A full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay from deployment block 23337251 to 25530887 gives the complete current role set: MINTER_ROLE = 0x4b1f9e5b20e8b9949b3db4b3ef5887f49d69c8dd (EOA); DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0xe584e152bed254a177351cea587aa44c2a83a8ae (EOA); PAUSER_ROLE = one EOA; UPGRADER_ROLE = no holder. Because DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the role admin of UPGRADER_ROLE, the admin EOA can self-grant it and change mint logic, so canChangeMintLogic is true. The verified ERC20F source imposes no mint cap. Kinesis states it issues KAU against allocated gold bullion audited by Bureau Veritas; that constraint is contractual and off-chain, not enforced on-chain. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Inspectorate International Limited, part of Bureau Veritas, performs independent physical-metal audits on a semiannual cycle and reconciles vaulted gold to KAU circulation; the latest audit date is 2026-04-20 and the report was published 2026-06-03. No exact prudential stablecoin-issuer charter for Kinesis was located; virtual-asset and corporate registrations do not supply prudential reserve supervision.
